name: 冰蓝水感温和洁面乳款
description: 冰蓝水感视觉体系，温和洁净绵密泡沫，洗后不紧绷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, icy blue #D9EAF9 with translucent bubble accents for hero info and closing shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, gentle bubble-bokeh accents, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E8EEF4 and seamless studio backdrop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep ocean blue #2B5AA8 headlines on light fields
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in deep ocean blue #2B5AA8 inside thin-ring circles only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and upright tube scale across the set, centered stability
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean watery gentle skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, icy blue #D9EAF9, mist blue #A9CDEE and deep ocean blue #2B5AA8; cool soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and gentle translucent bubble accents; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube standing upright, full product visible and not clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product on the surface. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 2K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达温和洁净不紧绷的核心利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, product standing on the left half
shots.lighting: cool soft studio light from the front left, gentle contact shadow
shots.background: icy blue gradient #D9EAF9 with translucent bubble accents
shots.props: a few soft translucent bubble-bokeh accents, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% reserved for the callout plate
shots.textZone: one empty circular callout plate on the right, filled via 「{callout_1}」 at generation time
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube shown at a slight 3/4 angle standing on the left half, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Icy blue gradient background #D9EAF9 with a few soft translucent bubble accents, cool soft studio light from the front left, gentle contact shadow. One empty circular callout plate on the right 40%, left blank as generous negative space to receive 「{callout_1}」 at generation time. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy or percentage claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大过度清洁带来的紧绷困扰，引出温和方案
shots.camera: two matched vertical panels, identical frontal documentary framing on both sides
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light feeling drying; right panel cool soft light feeling comfortable
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched vertical panels with identical frontal documentary framing and identical lighting logic. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: an abstract patch of tight, dull skin-texture surface in muted grey-beige #D9D4CE under harsh flat light, conveying post-cleanse tightness without showing any real face. Right panel: {product} standing in cool soft light on near-white #F4F8FC conveying a comfortable gentle cleanse. The product occupies 50-60% of its panel, no extra whitespace, the two visual states carry the contrast with no text. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated before-and-after skin results, no statistics or percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入清晨洗脸的真实场景，营造清爽水感
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down onto the counter, candid handheld feel
shots.lighting: soft cool morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte light-stone bathroom counter #E8EEF4 with soft morning mist
shots.props: a folded towel and a small tray beside the product, not covering it
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} resting on a matte light-stone bathroom counter #E8EEF4 with soft morning mist around it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the counter, candid handheld feel. Soft cool morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow. Props: a folded towel and a small tray beside the product, not covering it. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with the counter scene as the co-star, no extra whitespace. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用绵密细腻的泡沫实拍证明温和亲肤的质地
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the foam, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the right revealing fine foam texture, cool tone
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF blown to a soft haze
shots.whitespace: minimal, the foam detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of dense fine foam whipped from {product}, tight zoom on the airy foam surface resting on a wet palm. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foam foreground sharp. Soft skimming light from the right revealing the fine texture, cool tone. Pure white background #FFFFFF blown to a soft haze. The foam detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace as the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking foam, no deformed fingers or extra fingers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow

shots.props: five empty frosted circular bubbles arranged along the ring
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper 20% for a headline
shots.textZone: upper headline strip plus five blank bubbles, filled via 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_5}」 at generation time
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce ingredient-style infographic for {product}, flat lay shot from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle with the tube standing upright at center. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Icy blue background #D9EAF9 with one thin ring circle around the product and five empty frosted circular bubbles arranged along it, each bubble left blank as a proof placeholder to receive 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_5}」 at generation time. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame as a flat-lay panorama, generous negative space in the upper 20% for a headline. One empty embossed seal frame and one blank thin-line label strip beside the product, both left blank as proof placeholders to receive 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 composited in post-production. shots.lighting: even soft studio light with soft contact shadows
shots.background: icy blue #D9EAF9 with translucent bubble accents
shots.props: one empty rounded CTA button plate below the products
shots.textZone: empty rounded CTA button plate below the products, filled via 「{callout_1}」 at generation time

Icy blue background #D9EAF9 with a few translucent bubble accents, even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：1 冰蓝气泡主视觉，白管银盖洁面乳居中，标题主打温和洁净不紧绷；2 四枚细线功效图标与产品信息卡（品名滋润洁净洗面奶、适用所有肤质），信息卡含素材站字样与模板填充的规格与保质期数值；3 三条洁面困扰（过度洁净紧绷、易过敏、换季泛红脱皮）与1-4编号卖点列表，模特面部出镜；4 成分气泡环图，标注五大成分但气泡出现重复名称、数量自相矛盾；5 双图标卖点（温和不刺激、柔和亲肤）配双手捧泡沫实拍；6 两步使用法，图框被会员徽标与二维码遮挡。品类判定：图内品名为洗面奶、功效图标与泡沫实拍、洁面步骤均为面部护理硬证据，判护肤个护/面部护理，源夹名洗护不作为品类依据。已剥离：素材站品牌字样、模特面部、会员徽标与二维码、模板填充的容量与保质期数值、自相矛盾的成分名单；修复类功效表述一律以占位符承接，不作为事实写入。
